name: The District at Tustin Legacy
description: The District at Tustin Legacy is a premier open-air lifestyle center located in the heart of Orange County's dynamic Tustin Legacy development, featuring a curated mix of upscale retailers, popular dining destinations, and entertainment venues. This modern shopping destination offers a walkable, pedestrian-friendly environment that combines convenience with an elevated shopping and dining experience. As part of the master-planned Tustin Legacy community built on the former Marine Corps Air Station, The District serves as the retail and social hub for this thriving mixed-use development.
demographics: The District at Tustin Legacy attracts an affluent, educated demographic with median household incomes exceeding $100,000, primarily consisting of young professionals, families with children, and tech industry workers from nearby companies. The trade area serves the rapidly developing Tustin Legacy master-planned community along with surrounding Orange County suburbs, drawing visitors aged 25-54 who seek upscale dining, entertainment, and lifestyle retail experiences. Shoppers here demonstrate preferences for premium casual brands, experiential retail, and frequent dining visits, reflecting the center's positioning as a modern lifestyle destination rather than traditional shopping mall.
summary: A vibrant open-air lifestyle center featuring upscale retail, dining, and entertainment in Orange County's modern Tustin Legacy community.
